note: Airline, TSA, Amtrak and Greyhound policies for the Appalachian Trail guide's travel section. JetBlue, Alaska Air Cargo and Frontier pages were read directly on 2026-11-21 (cruise guide research, docs/investigations/cruise-ship-ashes-2026-11/research/travel-with-remains.json); the others were checked through search summaries of their official pages on 2026-11-25 because those sites are blocked in this environment.

airlines.name: American Airlines
airlines.carryOn: Yes. American treats the remains as your carry-on bag.
airlines.special: An airport agent may ask TSA whether the container can go as carry-on or checked.

airlines.name: Delta Air Lines
airlines.special: We found no cremated remains policy on Delta's own website. Ask Delta before you fly.

airlines.name: United Airlines
airlines.carryOn: Recommended. United suggests carrying the remains as a carry-on bag.
airlines.special: United asks travelers to review TSA's guidelines.

airlines.name: Southwest Airlines
airlines.carryOn: Yes, under certain conditions. TSA inspects the container at the checkpoint.
airlines.special: A temporary plastic or cardboard container is recommended.

airlines.name: JetBlue
airlines.carryOn: Yes, in an urn. It does not count toward your carry-on or personal item allowance.
airlines.special: Bring a certified copy of the death certificate and a document from the funeral director or crematorium to the ticket counter. Stow the urn under the seat or in an overhead bin.

airlines.name: Alaska Airlines
airlines.special: Stated on Alaska Air Cargo's page, which refers travelers to TSA for screening.

airlines.name: Frontier Airlines
airlines.carryOn: Yes, in a container of a material like wood or plastic that TSA can screen.
airlines.checked: Yes, packed in a well-insulated, sturdy container.
airlines.special: Frontier does not accept human remains for shipment.

airlines.name: Spirit Airlines
airlines.special: News reports say Spirit ceased flight operations on May 2, 2026. We found no current Spirit policy and no official confirmation of a restart.
